subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: After the Codex terminal-release bug and merge conflict are fixed, should OpenClaw accept `agents.*.iterationBudget`, `onBeforeToolCallingRound`, and `supportsIterationBudget` as the release contract?
rationale: The PR adds public config and harness/plugin API semantics; code review can identify defects, but maintainers must decide the stable names, defaults, and unsupported-harness behavior before shipping.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Fix the Codex terminal-release path, resolve the branch conflict, and merge with the current opt-in config/harness contract.

options.title: Rename or narrow first
options.body: Change the config keys, defaults, or hook semantics before release if maintainers do not want this exact compatibility contract.

options.title: Pause behind the canonical issue
options.body: Leave the design in the linked maxTurns/maxToolCalls issue if the hard-budget contract is not ready to bless.
